exec: pm.test('error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Username and password do not match'));
pm.test('five products with id, name, price, stock', () => { pm.expect(list).to.have.lengthOf(5); list.forEach(p => pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('id','name','price','stock')); });
pm.test('only the Desk Lamp', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.name)).to.eql(['Desk Lamp']));
pm.test('cart has the product with qty 2', () => { pm.expect(cart.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(cart.items[0]).to.include({ productId: Number(pm.environment.get('productId')), qty: 2 }); });
pm.test('lists email and PIN errors', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.eql(['Enter a valid email address','PIN code must be 6 digits']));
pm.test('order has id, items and ship-to', () => { pm.expect(o.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(o.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(o.shipTo.postalCode).to.eql('560019'); });
